posts.title: My Part in The God of Dorabaebasic by Cinemat and More - Geometry Dash
posts.author: SupaCLUCK
posts.desc:
Earlier this year, Chainlost reached out to me and asked if I wanted to build in a massive collab called The God of Dorabaebasic. Being someone who admires and frequently builds levels that resemble older styles in GD, I was naturally interested. I decided to go with the first part of segment 12/15, which uses Sourcream as the song and is based on 2.0. 
I replayed the dorabaebasic series prior to building to get some inspiration on how DORABAE built, such as his typical gameplay, structuring, design, and effect habits. You can probably tell that a lot of this was based on dorabae-basic12, but with my own touch to keep it original and modernize it for the collab. Even though it's a relat…...

posts.title: "QUARANTINE" by ciibule (Harder 7*) [3 Coins]
posts.author: Radar
posts.desc:
As an effect creator, this level really impressed me. I’m a big fan of all the wacky looking pulses and effects in “QUARANTINE”. I think for a level themed around this sort of computery/glitchy style Ciibule did a fantastic job. The blues and reds complement the white background very nicely. There’s a bunch of cool art pieces and area effects incorporated into a lot of the blocks as well to keep things super interesting and eye-catching. I’m not usually a fan of the use of inverted gradients, but for this style of level I think it works really nicely. 

My favorite segment is probably the wave at 0:20. Very cool block decoration with the blue blocks and error messages inside them. The masking in that segment is al…...

Project #9: TOTC Anniversary Edition
Started: 3/20/26
Finished: 9/27/26

A little late to the third anniversary but better late than never. TOTC was always the black sheep on the TM channel to me. It did what it set out to do well: copy K3 rooms and decorate the layout in a very barebones, readable way. However, this didn't really pass for deco even in 2.1. posts.author: Ice Rod
posts.desc:
I've taken a listen out of nowhere of Cacola's Requiem album on my bus ride home a couple days ago, and it's safe to say it's moved me a lot. It's quite crazy how consistent Cacola is at producing such divine sounding music. The ending especially moved me, and I had a small vision which I surprisingly managed to execute quite swiftly. it's probably my 2nd smallest level so far, though I believe one of my more artistic works and I am proud of what I've made. I had a lot of fun as well, though I fear about the reception a lot, since I don't typically show off this genre of levels publicly. 

Give Requiem a listen, it's such an incredible album

Видео было создано в основном для более ппродвинутых пользователей, не нужно писать в комментариях аля "почму ты не рассказал как пользоваться кнопками?" и подобного рода вопросы. posts.title: EPÍLOGO (September)
posts.author: Nezuu
posts.desc:
Este es probablemente el último video que suba a este canal.

Después de tantos años haciendo cosas en Geometry Dash, quise cerrar esta etapa de una forma que realmente tuviera sentido para mí. Este layout es una especie de epílogo, recorriendo y revisitando distintas etapas de todo lo que hice durante estos últimos 6 años, incluyendo cosas que probablemente ya ni recordaba.

Más que hacer un layout nuevo, quería mirar un poco hacia atrás. Ver cómo fui cambiando, las cosas que hice, las que dejé a medias, las que en su momento significaron mucho para mí y, sobre todo, recordar a toda la gente que estuvo ahí durante este camino.

A mis amigos, a la gente con la que hice collabs, a quienes jugaron mis niveles, a quienes me ayudaron, me inspiraron…...

Hello everyone! I know that many of you were not expecting me to release a new level today, so surprise!!! This level was originally meant to be a low effort project made for my brothers, but as always, I accidentally spent a lot of time on it lol. Surprisingly, this level actually has around the same amount of in-editor hours as my other level 'Touch the Orbs Bub." This style of level is actually so hard to make, and making this level made me gain a lot of respect for other levels that use default blocks in ways that feel uniquely like Geometry Dash. (Ocean of Fish, Dino Level, etc.)

Hey everyone! After such a long time, here I am again! I disappeared for a while because Geometry Dash was becoming really hard to keep up with as a full-time maintenance technician who also goes to college at night. 😅

However, with my life finally starting to stabilize again, Ghost invited me to this INCREDIBLE project, which literally pulled me out of the burnout I was going through with GD. Now I'm having fun again and actually wanting to build things in this game! Expect more stuff from me over the next few months.

Anyway, this was such a fun project. I had SO MUCH fun working on it, and it was an unbelievably great experience. I really hope you guys enjoy the level and have as much fun playing it as I had making it! :)

posts.title: [BEST] Steel Bloom n Rain ~ solo
posts.author: sayonarofc
posts.desc:
tgc: https://t.me/sayonarofc


I can’t believe I actually finished this.

This level took 9 months to create, and those were probably some of the hardest months of my life. I went through all of it alongside this level, and I’m insanely happy that it’s finally over.

This level became my hardest mental challenge in the game. At one point, I just started to hate everything about it — my close friends can confirm that. I would rage at the game, tilt constantly, and sometimes I even felt like crying whenever I opened the editor.

I present to you my best solo — Steel Bloom n Rain.

A little about the level.

The entire level is packed with local references. There are tons of different graffiti pieces scattered throughout it, referencing my friends who supported me throughout this entire journey.

I also made extensive use of random-based gim...

posts.title: С ДНЕМ РОЖДЕНИЯ!
posts.author: СТРАХ
posts.desc:
Честно, не думал что построю этот гп так быстро, залил его 17.06.26, а до др еще почти 2 месяца. Забавно, что из-за звездочек на бг в уровне 32к объектов, но это ваще не роляет. 
Поздравляю с твоим совершеннолетием Тимофей! Думаю к моменту выхода в свет этого шедеврального геймплея ты наконец-таки прошел свой новый хардест и выложил все экстримы которые прошел еще год назад (хотя в этом я очень сильно сомневаюсь). 
В прошлом году я планировал сделать геймплей на твой др, но что-то не сложилось, за это я очень сильно извиняюсь. Да я начинал его строить, но сил для завершения не хватило. Я думал насчет того, чтобы достроить его в этом году на твой день рождения, но все-таки решил сделать новый гп под новый сонг. 
Вообщем, я желаю тебе всего самого наилучшего и пройти слаутер! С днем рождения бебзена.

На представленном изображении мы видим сцену, выполненную в стиле киберпанка или футуристического цифрового искусства. Это не просто статичный кадр — перед нами скорее динамичная сцена из видеоигры с акцентом на интерактивность и технологичность.

▌ Детальный разбор изображения

1. Общий фон
Фон выполнен в глубоких тёмных тонах, которые создают ощущение бесконечного пространства. Он покрыт текстурой, напоминающей переплетение волокон или цифровых помех. Эта текстура придаёт сцене объём и глубину, а также подчёркивает её цифровую природу. Визуально это напоминает интерфейс виртуальной реальности или киберпространства: здесь нет привычных нам физических объектов, только абстрактные формы и светящиеся элементы управления.

posts.title: "Princess Demon" by BreadKing (Easy Demon) | Duality Gauntlet Entry
posts.author: Radar
posts.desc:
Creating with limitations can often lead to some incredibly memorable experiences. Made with entirely 2.0 restrictions, "Princess Demon" by BreadKing, is an outstanding entry for the Duality Gauntlet contest. There are so many original 2.0 levels that this level pays homage to, it’s packed full of nostalgia and creativity. Upon immediate viewing you can tell that this level calls back to a much more primitive time in the game's history, when creators and players often had to use their own imagination and suspend their disbelief to tell what was being shown within levels. It’s immediate to me that this level was made as a love letter to the game and levels within it, showing a deep appreciation for art made inside the editor.

posts.title: What Our Duality Gauntlet Entry Could Have Been.
posts.author: IvanPercie
posts.desc:
Our hypothetical entry for the Duality Gauntlet, the theme was essentially 2 players, blending two dimensional planes in each section Blocks in 2D and background in 3D, or vice versa, and working with two colors.

Since we’re not kids anymore and live in a third-world country we didn’t have much time to fully focus on the project. Even so, we achieved a very satisfying result for just two months of work on the level.

The deadline and the object limit didn’t match the level of polish we wanted to achieve, so we decided to cancel the entry and finish things more carefully at our own pace.

Акт 1: Мирная жизнь («Первый слой реальности»)
Утро начинается как обычно. Солнце встаёт над небольшим прибрежным городком, где люди занимаются своими делами: кто-то выгуливает собак, кто-то покупает кофе. На первом плане — группа студентов, обсуждающих планы на выходные. Никаких намёков на беду. Единственная странность — на небе видна едва заметная рябь, будто кто-то растягивает плёнку. Никто не обращает внимания.

Акт 2: Первые сигналы («Сбой в системе»)
Внезапно у всех горожан одновременно начинают звенеть телефоны. На экранах появляется одно и то же сообщение: «Мы идём. Не прячьтесь. Мы уже здесь». Отправитель неизвестен. Люди начинают паниковать. When I first started this level, I was just making it for fun. I didn't have a release date in mind or even know when I'd finish it. As I kept working on it little by little, a friend was watching me build it and said, Why don't you make it for Duality? I replied, Nah, why would I? haha. Then he answered, Come on, it has that duality in the decoration. I thought about it and said, Alright, I'll give it a try.

posts.desc:
I started this project in February under the name 'Thin Line'. Initially, it was intended to be one of several low-effort releases on my birthday (4 August), but I quickly became attached to the idea of entering it into the Duality Gauntlet Contest. With Middle Window, I have tried to portray real life and its regular ups and downs.

The level begins with a glass prism, which symbolises how something as dull as white light can transform into a captivating display of colour. In case it wasn't already clear, I tried to associate the monochromatic palette (black and white) with negative feelings, while the colours represent the joy and happiness that we always need. 

The second section features a substantial element: the Eye, which represents how others and you perceive yourself. We sometimes allow the thoughts of others and ourselves to in...

posts.desc:
Drifting Fortune is my duality gauntlet contest entry that touches on my personal growth during my first year of college, representing my transition out of isolation and my resulting drift into a fortunate life. The duality theme is shown through two contrasting settings: one setting being a colorless room scene, and the other setting being a warm and colorful outside environment, where the transition between the two is marked by a line of dominoes. 

Something I’d realized in life is that I shouldn’t be content with just existing on this planet. I spent a whole quarter of college believing I was content, but in reality I was very isolated from everyone. rYxUE is a very cool remake of the former top 30, qoUEO, a special level that's basically a challenge list wave level (at the time it was made) followed by an easy extreme afterwards. It was definitely one of the more accessible list demons and a favorite of people's due to the chill nature of it. This level is basically qoUEO but it's themed pretty differently, and uses ship instead of wave. You might not think it's top 10 because of how short it is, the how easy the second half is, but that ship part is borderline impossible, and something you'd find in a level nearing Aeternus in difficulty. Super ridiculous part. The level looks pretty sick so far especially at the start, can't wait to see the finished product

posts.desc:
As promised in the description of Elysium Mons Preview 2, a fun, quick side project that originally wasn’t in my scheduled line up.

I present to you the new and improved official version of Azure Flare! 

Had a lot of fun building this, took me about a month or so. I always liked this song and I was upset that it wasn’t used in anything more decent, and I always thought endlevel’s original version had lots of potential (Mainly because of the first wave), and endlevel had handed me the level, so I just decided why not. I wanted to push this level to its fullest potential while still feeling like a classic NC.

I’m not really sure how hard this will end up, but the goal is to have it as hard as it can possibly be while still being fun. Do NOT expect this to be anywhere NEAR top 1 because if it was it would be the worst thing ever.

posts.author: mordroc7
posts.desc:
Hello again!

Long time no see! For those of you who may have thought you would never see an upload from me again, I was one of you for a while. This level is actually not new; it was finished in early December of 2025, but it took an absurdly long time to get effects finished, and then I honestly forgot the level existed for a while after it was basically finished, but now here it is! I am proud to present my first solo in (I think?) over a year!

This is one of those songs I always wanted to build to but could never find the motivation to. I love Camellia, but the conquest of building a minute+ layout to one of his songs seemed too daunting to even attempt. Then, one day, I was bored in my room and just said, "why not!" and started building. One idea led to another, creativity blossomed, and now you have this layout in front of you here...

This is PAST THE NIGHT, a Geometry Dash level that is an entry for the Duality Gauntlet Contest.

This feels surreal to have done. If you've been following my work for a long time, you may remember this being uploaded about a year ago under the name "Scrapped Level 3". I started this project in March of last year, but beyond the first part, I was completely drained for ideas. Even as I improved and released better and better levels, the first part of this level still stood as a monument, something that even to this day I believe is up there with my best creations. I had been itching to finish this for so long, but I couldn't find the ideas or motivation to continue.

posts.desc: This project has been something of a rollercoaster from the very start. It began in September 2023 with a host line-up consisting of Panya, Elyxx, and Flimmin, but everyone was extremely busy. I ended up starting solo with just one part, Autumnflowa along with the half-part visualisation of Xolarzz. Thanks to Feedowkskiy, we later gained three new parts (vExon, Elley, and his own), and around the New Year, I brought on Detter, Jelkso, Devastation, Bleedflxwer, and Sram to build their parts. However, a wave of demotivation hit me between March and April 2024. I became passive, prioritizing other collabs like Fright, while my motivation fluctuated. TURN ON SUBTITLES/CAPTIONS FOR THE BEST EXPERIENCE.

i've had alot of emotions bottled up for a long time, but recently my anxiety got worse and worse, until i've had one of my worst mental breakdowns just this week. i gave in to depression and stayed home, instead of celebrating chinese new year with my family. i couldnt tell anyone about my current state, i am a mess now.

this is a layout i have wanted to make for a while. its not objectively good or fun to play, but it is emotional release. i grinded this for 10 hours in one sitting. i hope this inspires anyone as much as it did myself.

i am so tired.

posts.author: marwec
posts.desc:
this is my first (and probably my last) layout collab and it was so much fun to create! seeing 3,5 minutes of gameplay merged together for the first time after seeing so many standalone banger parts really made me proud of all the people that worked on this.

what i wanted the overarching theme to be was focus on the layout and structuring by keeping the project mostly grayscale while also not making it visually boring. i wished for the song to be able to showcase everyone‘s talent in a way so that already known people could cement their status and more unknown people would be able to shine. i believe that the final product isn’t only incredibly exciting but also extraordinarily coherent for a level style that usually promotes highly individual building styles. i hope that this will be a layout people will come back to watch (and play) fo...

posts.author: [cherry] team
posts.desc:
Not long ago, we were advised to pick up this level for decoration because it’s reported to be fun to play, has a great feel to it, and is generally well-loved by the slayer community.

The structures, unfortunately, were a total nightmare — you can see them on the left. They were honestly hideous and completely impossible to decorate. On top of that, there were major camera issues that we also had to fix. Finally, the difficulty wasn't quite right; the level's potential clearly allowed for something much harder than Wasureta difficulty.

We managed to overhaul everything (including the structures, camera, and difficulty) in just 48 hours. The buffs were especially challenging; we spent the bulk of our time on them over those two days. Also, weird annoying bug I found with this part is that low opacity gradients break when color adjusting shaders are used on them. posts.title: To Tango (2-Player collab with Viot, ft. Pocke)
posts.author: illybwoy
posts.desc:
Around the end of last year, my friend Lyrae mentioned that a 2 Player Level Contest hosted by Lia and Gecko just started. My impulsive thoughts flowed in and i immediately went to ask Viot @reusablechopsticks7784  if we could collab, creator of cool 2p levels/layouts like Take Two and Otherlands. We go way back since Mazl’s layout tournaments, he then pivoted to doing more decoration while i stayed in the same lane mostly. But this time i wanted to actually try and deco. This is one of my hardest challenges in the game so far.

In the end, I made 60% gameplay 40% deco, and Viot made 40% gameplay 50% deco. I really love how it all turned out, we sent progress to each other very often so the cohesion turned out well. This was supposed to be a remake of the deleted Youkai Woods layout by Xzer. I remember starting this after realizing that the original layout was lost. Hence, as a tribute, I started this way back in 2.1. I occasionally come back to this and place just a few blocks and then quit out.

I really enjoy watching (and playing!) this layout, even in this unfinished state. Especially the implementation of the fakes, I admire. It forces the player to actually explore the level rather than surviving absurt timings and such. I may confidently say that this is one of the best works I have ever made, although it is a remake - wish I could credit the original level.

If you ever recall the remaining sections, or just want to finish it up, you may hit me on discord, which I will leave below:

posts.desc:
I beat this earlier today but I wasn't recording, so I went back and recorded a bot showcase so I could upload it.

I like this layout/level a lot, I think both of these goobers did such a good job with it. I like how they take inspiration from the original MV while still incorporating their own art and direction into the visuals. I think the gameplay is a lot more enjoyable to watch than to play, but I think that's also kinda the point of this, it wasn't really made with the intention of being played.. However, this isn't to say that it's bad to play. It's actually quite fun if you treat it like a memory level. posts.title: Clubstep Monster (unfinished)
posts.author: w
posts.desc:
This is another old work started way back in 2.1. I always liked listening to Clubstep; thus, I felt the need of creating a layout with it. Again, I occasionally come back to this and place a few blocks.

As you can see, it is a 1.9 gameplay with tons of fakes and confusing factors. I feel like 1.9 gameplay is inherently simple, you do not have many tools to create mechanically impressive layouts. Instead, I try to implement the fakes in 1.9 to actually blend the old memory levels and my current style (although not that current, this is quite old). This is heavily influenced by Clubstep and Tartarus, as you might recognize. 

If you ever want to play or finish this, you may hit me on discord:

posts.title: Spin Cycle by RadiationV2 (extreme demon - showcase)
posts.author: RadiationV2
posts.desc:
Surprise! Didnt expect to finish any new level in the near future, but I was told about DemonTime recently and had this undecoed gameplay sitting around. Decided the flow of the layout and its song were both too good to go to waste and wanted to try a more lax design approach again, like I did it back in 2.0 / early 2.1, with less thinking and more building. As such, I didnt plan overthink or redo most designs and I mostly stuck to what I'm used to or to simple ideas. I managed to deco this level in the span of two weeks over reasonably lengthed sittings somehow, which is extremely short compared to my usual works, which can take upwards of 8 months! 

The channel hitting 2k subs was also part of the motivation for this, so we can call it the 2k special as well. Hope you like it, and thanks for the support! :D

posts.title: MY BEST LEVEL | entropie by empsea (me)
posts.author: empsea
posts.desc:
In my opinion, this is my best level, better than Kisaragi, NEO Sound, and my part in ORBIT.

I've been building this level almost every day for 11 months, starting around late July – early August of last year. It was initially supposed to be a random gauntlet entry, which explains why there are a bunch of random trigger mechanics scattered around the level, but I severely underestimated the amount of time this would eventually take. By the time of the deadline, I only had various parts half-finished, so I decided to try and make this my best level, which I believe I succeeded at in both gameplay and visuals.

I was going to submit this level for the duality gauntlet, but I realized that would be pretty stupid and unfair to other people entering, considering it doesn't even fit the theme.

Hosted by me, 149 Creators in total, 230 Days in the works, the first Megacollab I finished myself!

-

Story:

Apollyon was started more or less on a whim on the 20th October 2025. It was an incredibly ambitious project to pick up. A level being 13 minutes long and decorated throughout? Many people think that it would take multiple years at the very least, but that wasn't really my concern.

The level started of strong, with the Full Layout being finished just a week after it had started, that already seemed incredible, and starting the decorating phase we continued pushing and managed to have 1/3 of the level finished 2 months into the level being created.

posts.author: TwanDash
posts.desc:
A level that started out as a "break" for both of us quickly became the main focus since we did not feel like working on our bigger projects that much.

Ive had such a blast building this with Peer. He's super underrated and lowkey carried this hard. I got a whole new vision into creating because of him so I'll be forever thankfull!

Creating this took us about 5 months which was WAY more than we ever expected it to take. It almost feels embarrasing saying that... 
I do feel like it was time well spent and I think we can both say that Kalpa has made us both better creators in alot of aspects. 

Creating this felt like a feverdream sometimes because of the amout of abstract art and the extreme focus on song representation. This was also the main thing I've personally learned from building this.

What you see before you is the main reason why I now try to avoid hosting collabs in general. I still remember how I watched the modus live broadcast on a summer evening in mid-August 2025, especially how he and Llovió made a song and, oh my God, how wonderful it turned out for them. After that, I started waiting for the song to become available on the Newgrounds.

The level was originally planned as a collab on New Year's or Christmas 2025 holidays (it doesn't really make sense which holiday it is. The main thing is that it's in winter). Later I started calling creators to unite them and together make a wonderful New Year's level that would surely stick in the hearts of GD community for a long time. posts.author: Motleyorc
posts.desc:
ID: 143517648

After ~3 years, this level is finally finished! I can't say much other than this project has gone through development hell for a very long time; it was basically a day 1 2.2 project, and was intended to be EXTREMELY long in scope (50+ rooms instead of 9...)

I built my room in very early 2.2, it's somewhat unimpressive (partially due to me not having touched the editor in years at that point), as well as some extremely tight object/group constraints.

I am extremely happy with how this level turned out, massive props to Fungifity and Subwoofer for their work on this. I wish I could have been more involved with the development of this level, but I am happy with my contributions (alongside with helping a lot with testing!).

posts.author: Kwol
posts.desc:
⭐⭐⭐    ⭐  ⭐  ⭐

This is my biggest level to date, 4 minutes, 129k objects, 200+ groups and 100+ colors throughout 5 months of work. Originally started for SilvrPS's "That's 2.0 ASF!" contest in November. Yeah.. I highkey wasn't finishing this in one month.. 
The level takes inspiration from levels and creators of the mid-late 2.0 update. Some parts take inspiration directly from levels such as: Beautiful Now by ValentInsanity for parts 1 and 4; Niflheim by vismuth for part 5; Forever Bound by BobRatchet for part 9. Also, the level is made entirely in 2.0 editor (with 2.2 bug fixes). 
Special thanks to the guys from SilvrPS discord server, they gave lots of useful feedback throughout the building process. Special thanks to unbihexium for support and feedback too.

могу лишь сказать, что въебал в эту игру 2500 часов своей жизни всего за 1 год, не достигнув того, что я хотел... но вместо этого я получил нечто куда большее. я познакомился с огромным количеством ахуительных людей, с которыми я могу поговорить о всем, что хочу, которые поддержат меня в моих решениях и начинаниях. меня настолько затянуло это коммьюнити, что я, развиваясь, забывал о происходящем в реальной жизни бля))) при этом гд помогла мне понять и познать себя.

но несмотря на это, встречал множество прям отбитых дегенератов, выставлявших любых людей, кроме своих кентов на посмешище. не понимаю я их... но похуй, они все равно не могли перечеркнуть тех, кто помогал, когда было нужно, кто понимал т...

posts.title: Opium (My Best Level)
posts.author: Atomic Rest
posts.desc:
Level ID: 143410071

I understand you probably weren’t expecting this from the same creator who made two of the silliest levels in GD history. I really enjoyed creating Opium, as it was so different from my typical style. I wanted to try something new, focusing on atmosphere, song representation, and symbolism.

I am blessed that substance abuse hasn’t played a significant role in my life, but friends around me that I see every day and care about are in a constant struggle. This level is a story about addiction, but from an outside point of view. Rather than being told from the perspective of the addict, it’s told from the perspective of a family member. I made this level to show how addiction doesn’t just affect oneself, but those around you, and those you love. If you or someone you know is suffering from addiction, this level...
